rules.standings_policy: Use league rank to support direct A-vs-B strength and rank-weight shared common opponents C. The legacy unranked common-opponent 12% term is retired and its weight is transferred to the ranked standings context, increasing that adjustment layer from 20% to 32%. If standings are unavailable, fall back to the core form model without rejecting the match solely for missing standings.
rules.confidence_policy: Calculated per match from core NOMAD strength plus ranked standings A-B-C context; publish only confidence >= 58%; no artificial cap below the natural 100% percentage ceiling
rules.publication_policy: Rank confidence high-to-low and publish at most 10 qualifying picks; fewer or zero picks are valid
rules.rollover_policy: Start the next automatic selection only after every pick in the current set is settled and final statistics are recorded
